proof_body:
by
  intro P a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    simp [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_pow]
  · rintro ⟨h0, hd⟩
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (show P.IsRoot a from h0)
    have hGa : G.IsRoot a := by
      have h := congrArg (fun p => (Polynomial.derivative p).eval a) hG
      have h' : P.derivative.eval a = G.eval a := by
        simpa [Polynomial.derivative_mul] using h
      rw [Polynomial.IsRoot, ← h', hd]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hGa
    exact ⟨Q, by rw [hG, hQ]; ring⟩
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℝ) (a : ℝ), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ 2 ∣ P ↔ P.eval a = 0 ∧ P.derivative.eval a = 0
